method: built-in image_gen; fresh generation; no raster editing

prompts.everyday:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a BRAND-NEW, meticulously rendered Expadu Today interface concept from a blank canvas. This is original generation, not editing, upscaling, repainting, or compositing an earlier screenshot. Use the highest native resolution available, aiming for 3072 × 2048, landscape 3:2. Vector-sharp text and icons, natural crisp event photography, clean smooth surfaces. No noisy texture, muddy gradients, distorted glyphs, sharpened artifacts or blurry type.

COMPOSITION: One desktop app screen on the left (about 70% of the board) and one narrow phone app screen on the right (about 25%), separated by a small gutter. Both front-facing, no perspective, no physical device hardware. Show finished complete desktop and mobile layouts of the SAME adaptive state. Maintain the accepted assistant-led layout: personal agenda and its journey on the desktop left; a smaller Paperwork panel on the desktop right with City help beneath; event photography across the bottom. On mobile stack personal content, saved ideas, Paperwork, City help, then one horizontal event rail with a next-card edge. On an important-event day a single compact image spotlight can lead. This is roughly 70% practical daily help and 30% event discovery, never an events-only website.

VISUAL SYSTEM: Very pale cool canvas #F5FAFB, clean white surfaces, nearly-black primary type #191C20, muted slate supporting text, orange #F04B22 for actions and the agenda connection, cyan #08B5D3 for travel and selection, pale cyan #DFF4F8 journey strips, a restrained very pale lavender Paperwork surface, pale yellow for disruption information. Dark primary text must stay black, not electric blue or purple. Crisp contemporary sans serif like Inter, restrained soft corners, elegant compact spacing and touch targets. No heavy borders or black dividers. Use delicate fading separators only. No new sidebars, bottom menus, huge white information blocks or big filled CTA bars.

HEADER: Existing simple orange/cyan E-like brand mark with “Expadu”; city “Cologne” with a compact pin/down chevron; bookmark with small badge “3”; account circle “A”. Two-row top header. Menu in existing position: “Today”, “Events”, “Paperwork”, “Travel”, “Services”. One coherent small monoline icon family, cyan home, violet event/calendar, orange document, cyan front-facing train with short rail feet, muted four-square services symbol. Today selected with one soft cyan pill; no second underline. Mobile has all five names visible, smaller regular labels, aligned small icons and compact height. Do not redesign the logo or Composer.

GREETING: “Today, Anar.” with only the final dot orange. Under it “Wed 30 Sept · Sample day”. A small sun and “21°” in the content heading, once per screen. This is sample data and event photographs are illustrative.

KEY GROUPING RULE: The confirmed appointment and the journey required to reach it are ONE agenda item. Start with heading “Your day”, ONE orange timeline node and a thin orange vertical line, a large bold “14:00”, title “Your appointment”, secondary location “Mülheim”, green “Confirmed” badge, and a small neutral horizontal dots menu at the right. Nest the journey summary directly BELOW these appointment details, inside this SAME grouping. The journey never receives another timeline dot, another equal-weight heading, or a separate top-level timeline row. No duplicate appointment later in the agenda. The vertical agenda line ends at the bottom of this one appointment group. Below the group show a simple orange “+ Add a plan” action, no decorative circle or calendar beside it.

JOURNEY DIRECTION: A single small cyan FRONT-FACING TRAIN identifier with rail feet at the left of the pale cyan journey strip. Departure and arrival columns clearly aligned. A fine cyan CONNECTING LINE runs left-to-right between the departure and arrival values, with small endpoint dots and ONE subtle rightward arrowhead; it indicates direction and is not an opening button. Keep this connector visible on desktop AND mobile. No large arrow in a round button, no extra bus glyph, no vertical divider between times.

SAVED IDEAS: A separate area below the agenda, labelled “Saved for later”, with “17:30”, “Language café” and a small orange outlined calendar-plus action at the right. This saved idea must not be shown as a confirmed timeline activity.

PAPERWORK: Small pale lavender surface labelled “Paperwork”, with a restrained orange document identifier. “EU Blue Card”, “1/5 documents”, five small progress segments with only the first orange. Below a soft separator, an orange small document/form identifier followed by “City registration”. The registration row has no invented progress, percentage, legal copy or second opening control. These rows open directly.

CITY HELP: A quiet text heading EXACTLY “City help”, WITHOUT any icon beside this heading. Below it three compact aligned city-tool shortcuts: four-square icon “Services”; the SAME front-facing train icon “Travel”; small sun icon “Forecast”. A sun belongs only to the weather/Forecast shortcut, never to City help itself. These tools remain outside Paperwork.

EVENT IMAGES: Photorealistic, naturally detailed evening Cologne scenes, real-looking people and warm string lights, not faceted illustrations. Small integrated title/time/location at the bottom over a restrained dark fading scrim; NO separate white information slab. Frosted translucent bookmark circle at top right, distinct small orange calendar-plus Plan circle at lower right. Ordinary-day cards: “Rhine-side live music”, “18:30–20:00”, “Rheinauhafen”; “Open-air cinema”, “20:00”, “Stadtgarten”. Desktop two wide image cards; mobile one readable horizontal rail with part of the next card. Do not make these photographs dominate the practical content.

COMPOSER: Preserve the current dark-teal round floating global launcher with the familiar white four-point sparkle, only once per screen. It sits at the bottom right, unobtrusive and not covering an action. The actual Composer tray is unchanged. The delay scenario additionally has the explicitly requested contextual white/orange Composer button next to Alternatives.

Avoid unrelated opening arrows/icons, repeated text buttons, decorative heading symbols, duplicate city tools, massive control heights, fake live status, legal advice, poster illustration artifacts and excessive empty space. All exact labels must be readable and correctly spelled. Render a polished original source, not a degraded iteration.
STRICT BASELINE LOCKS — these take precedence over any ambiguous layout wording above:
The desktop header MUST have TWO ROWS: brand plus city/Save/account utilities in row 1; Today / Events / Paperwork / Travel / Services alone in row 2. Never fit desktop logo, utilities and all navigation into one row. The phone also has the same two-row structure.
Keep the existing logo treatment: one black vertical rounded stroke, three short orange rounded horizontal strokes to its right, tiny cyan dot to its left, followed by black “Expadu”. Do not invent a cyan E logo.
The appointment is the VISUAL ANCHOR: “14:00” must be the biggest type in this group, on its OWN LINE above “Your appointment”, about 76px desktop / 46px phone in equivalent screen typography. Under that is “Mülheim”, then status chips. Neutral dots at the right. NEVER put the time and appointment title side by side as one compressed list row. The nested journey strip and delay recovery row sit UNDER the status chips. One orange node beside the big time, one thin orange group line; no second route node.
In the travel strip, put each scheduled time ABOVE its expected time in the delay state, not next to it. Connect the two bold expected times with a thin cyan line, small end dots and a small rightward arrowhead.
All Paperwork and City registration rows open directly. NO trailing chevrons, arrows, buttons or dots on these rows. NO arbitrary background card enclosing City help: its plain heading and three small pale-cyan tool circles sit on the canvas below Paperwork.
Event Plan buttons remain SOLID ORANGE with WHITE calendar-plus glyphs. Only the Alternatives pill and its adjacent contextual Composer circle have white fill + orange outline. Do not turn all event Plan actions into white outlined buttons.
Keep regular primary text black. No new blue typography. Native fine typography, monoline train/form icons, no oversize glyphs.

SCENARIO: EVERYDAY. The personal day leads; there is no disruption banner and no event hero above it. The appointment at “14:00” is the sole confirmed timeline item. Its nested cyan journey strip shows “Leave” and “13:24” on the left, “Arrive” and “13:52” on the right, one small train at its left edge, and a fine cyan connected line with a rightward arrowhead between times. Keep the connection clear on both desktop and phone. No second journey node, no additional equal-weight “Line 4” timeline item. Do not show Alternatives or a delay warning in this normal state. Keep the simple + Add a plan, separate Language café saved idea, Paperwork records, plain City help heading, compact city tools and two photographic events below.
prompts.important:
Generate a COMPLETELY NEW sharp Expadu UI screenshot board from a blank canvas, NOT an edit. Landscape3:2, highest native resolution. Show one desktop view at left, one narrow phone view at right. Clean modern daily companion, 70% practical content,30% event discovery. Pale cool white/cyan canvas, WHITE surfaces, BLACK type, orange actions, cyan travel/selection, pale lavender Paperwork. Inter-like sharp sans-serif, compact controls, outlined icons, no blurry letters. No perspective or device hardware.

HEADER GEOMETRY IS CRITICAL. In EACH view there are TWO SEPARATE HORIZONTAL ROWS, not one:
ROW1 (upper band): existing logo (BLACK vertical rounded bar, THREE ORANGE short horizontal bars, tiny CYAN dot) and “Expadu” at left; “Cologne”, bookmark badge3, circleA at right.
ROW2 (a separate band BELOW row1): five compact tabs. Their EXACT icon+label pairs are HOME outline +“Today”; CALENDAR outline +“Events”; DOCUMENT outline +“Paperwork”; FRONT-FACING TRAIN outline with rail feet +“Travel”; FOUR-SQUARE grid outline +“Services”. Today alone soft cyan selected pill, no underline. Both desktop and phone keep these SAME symbols, order and two rows. Mobile small regular labels below each icon. NEVER a calendar for Today, NEVER people for Events. Do not put desktop menu on logo's row.

Below header “Today, Anar.” orange final dot; smaller “Wed30 Sept ·Sample day”. Small sun+21° at far right beside greeting, no header weather.

IMPORTANT-EVENT STATE: Exactly ONE compact full-width desktop photographic spotlight below greeting, with matching mobile spotlight. Natural high-quality Cologne Rhine-side evening photo, sunset, real-looking musicians/crowd, string lights, skyline. Integrated lower image overlay “Street culture night”; “18:30–21:00”; pin “Rheinauhafen”; tiny “Illustrative event”. Small yellow “Tonight” chip, frosted translucent bookmark at upper right. Small SOLID ORANGE Plan circle at lower right containing ONLY a WHITE CALENDAR-PLUS GLYPH. Do not print the word Plan. No separate white information block.

Below hero desktop has agenda at left, smaller Paperwork at right. Mobile stacks agenda, saved idea, Paperwork, City help.

AGENDA: “Your day” heading. ONE orange timeline dot to left of large bold “14:00”, on its OWN LINE ABOVE “Your appointment”, then “Mülheim”, small GREEN Confirmed pill. Neutral horizontal dots at right.14:00 is the strongest/largest agenda text (about70px desktop/44px phone equivalent). ONE thin orange timeline line connects the appointment grouping, with NO second node/route timeline item.
DIRECTLY UNDER Confirmed nest ONE pale-CYAN travel strip: small front-facing cyan TRAIN ICON with rail feet, “Leave” above bold13:24 at left and “Arrive” above bold13:52 at right. A fine CYAN LINE with tiny endpoint dots and ONE small RIGHTWARD ARROWHEAD visibly connects those times in BOTH views. Not an action button. This journey belongs to the appointment.
Below group simple orange “+Add a plan” (no calendar, no circle).
Separate “Saved for later” area, inline “17:30 Language café”, small orange calendar-plus at right. Saved idea is not confirmed.

PAPERWORK: Small lavender surface, orange document beside heading “Paperwork”; “EU Blue Card”, “1/5 documents”, five progress segments first orange; below a soft separator small orange document/form before “City registration”, NO extra progress/statistics. NO trailing chevrons/arrows or repeated Open/Details buttons.
CITY HELP: plain heading “City help”, no icon at heading. Three aligned small PALE-CYAN circle shortcuts: FOUR-SQUARE “Services”; SAME TRAIN “Travel”; SUN “Forecast”. Sun only weather/Forecast. No sun beside City help.
Bottom a small plain “Events” text link, no arrow. Small current DARK-TEAL Composer circle with white four-point sparkle in bottom-right breathing room, no redesigned tray.

End the page after these practical sections. NO second event rail/grid, NO other event cards, NO “Events near you”, NO Rhine-side live music card, NO Open-air cinema card. No duplicated hero. All exact labels in readable black type. Prioritize same header, same icon meanings, large stacked appointment, cyan directional travel strip and icon-free City help. Make a fresh crisp source.

prompts.interactions:
Use case: ui-mockup. BRAND-NEW crisp Expadu interaction storyboard from a blank canvas. Aim2048 ×3072 portrait2:3, highest native resolution. No editing/upscaling earlier artwork. Pale cool canvas, clean white compact interface panels, black primary type, cyan travel/selection, orange actions, subtle lavender accents. Sharp monoline symbols and natural photographic events. NO slogans. Header: existing black/orange/cyan E-like mark +Expadu; compact menu Today / Events / Paperwork / Travel / Services, Today cyan pill, NO underline. Footer “Interaction proposal · Sample content”.

Four clearly separated stacked numbered sections. Captions concise. Storyboard connector arrows BETWEEN panels are explanatory, not app opening controls.

1. “Save and Plan”. Three small panels. First TWO are FULL-BLEED photo cards, natural Cologne Rhine music at sunset. Integrated bottom title “Rhine-side live music”, “18:30–20:00”, “Rheinauhafen”, “Sample event” over dark fading scrim; never separate photo and white information block. Each photo has small translucent frosted bookmark at upper-right and SOLID ORANGE round Plan button with WHITE calendar-plus at lower-right. First empty bookmark, second cyan filled saved bookmark + small “Saved” local feedback. Third panel compact proposal tile “Proposed ·18:30–20:00”, event name, small thumbnail, “Sample event”, “Review”. Captions “Save an idea”; “Plan separately”; “Review before adding”.

2. “Open the exact process”. Left small Paperwork surface showing ONLY ONE row: “EU Blue Card”, “1/5 documents”, five small segments first orange. No trailing opening icons. Right detail: “EU Blue Card”, “Your records”, a document symbol beside “Uploaded document”, “30 Sept2026”, small green recorded check. Caption “Tap the row · return keeps your place”. Do NOT include City registration on this storyboard; do NOT invent any0/5 or second progress count. No legal instructions, fees or requirements.

3. “One appointment, connected travel”. Left compact ONE appointment group.14:00 is LARGE on its OWN LINE above “Your appointment”, then “Mülheim”, green “Confirmed”, yellow “4 min late”, neutral horizontal dots. Exactly ONE orange timeline node at the14:00 start, connected thin orange group line with NO second/end node.
Nest a pale-cyan route strip UNDER appointment status: small badges “12 min delay”, “Simulated”; subordinate “Line4 ·Neumarkt →Mülheim”. One SMALL CYAN TWO-DIMENSIONAL MONOLINE TRAIN ICON with short rail feet. This icon is about20px, NOT a tram photo, not a large rendered vehicle, not a bus.
“Departure”: grey struck13:24 ABOVE bold13:36. “Arrival”: grey struck13:52 ABOVE bold14:04. Fine cyan connecting line with small end dots and one small rightward arrowhead between expected times. Below the cyan strip, within this group but separated by gap/fading divider: WHITE Alternatives pill, thin ORANGE border, ORANGE text; immediately beside it WHITE round contextual Composer button with matching ORANGE border and ORANGE four-point sparkle. No filled Alternatives, no blue recovery button.
Right depicts the EXISTING low white rounded Composer tray with three shallow rows, not a new chat card: top bookmark “3 in your plan” and closeX; middle the single-line draft “Help with Neumarkt →Mülheim” WITHOUT an inner bordered input box; bottom plus, “Ask first” dropdown, and simple UNFILLED muted violet upward send arrow. No filled orange Send button or redesigned controls. Caption “Route context ready · draft preserved · nothing sent”.

4. “Reveal, then remove”. First recognizable appointment card14:00 /Your appointment /Mülheim, small cyan train and connected route times, neutral dots with compact “Details / Remove” menu. Second SAME card moved a short distance left after swipe/double-tap, revealing a narrow RED circle with white trash on the right. Card remains recognizable; no full-row banner or red overlay. Third small WHITE or translucent confirmation with green check “Activity removed” and violet “Undo”, no black toast. Captions “Dots, swipe or double-tap”; “Tap revealed Delete to remove”; “Undo available”.
Consistent useful symbols, no decorative repeated icon headings, no invented data or extra text. City help, if present, is plain text with no sun icon. Fresh high-quality legible interface artwork.
